﻿# Prismata Dependency Inspector

A standalone tool for:

- schema-driven dependency extraction  
- manifest dependency resolution  
- fallback inference  
- renderer simulation  
- GUI visualization  

Run CLI:

python -m dependency_inspector --schema pane
python -m dependency_inspector --all

Run GUI:

python -m dependency_inspector --gui
